name: Spire Totem, Greater
body:
Spire Totem, Greater (Su)
Source Wilderness Origins pg. 24
While the barbarian is raging, all allies within 30 feet gain a +2 morale bonus on Will saves. When attempting a Will save against a fear effect, all allies within this area can roll twice and use the better result. A barbarian must have the spire totem rage power and be at least 10th level to select this rage power.
